name: ledgix
description: Ledgix by Ribanix Labs: shared, live, audited ledger books for business partners and suppliers. Free and open source PWA.

paragraphs: Shared, live ledger books for business partners and suppliers. By Ribanix Labs. Premium is free for everyone during early access.
Try it without an account: (sample data that stays in your browser; switch between the partner and the supplier, or open both side by side to watch changes appear live).

Many smartphone traders work like this: a partner buys phones from e-commerce sites or stores using credit-card offers, hands them to a supplier, and the supplier pays back the purchase amount plus a commission, timed around the partner's card due dates. Both sides usually keep their own notes, then spend hours reconciling.
features: Partners & suppliers: connect any number of businesses with a one-time invite link (WhatsApp share built in). Each side sees all of its counterparts.

Books: one open book per partnership. Close it whenever you agree; the balance carries forward as the opening balance of the next book. Closed books are locked (corrections go in as adjustments). The latest closed book…

One ledger for everything: purchases (amount + commission, merchant, card, quantity, models/IMEI, order ID, ordered/delivered/cancelled), payouts (UPI/NEFT/IMPS/RTGS/cash/cheque with UTR) and adjustments.
Commission later: a purchase can be saved without a commission; the supplier fills it in. Negative commissions are allowed (market losses). Calculator for % of amount or per unit.

Two-sided confirmation: every new entry or material change (amount, commission, date, type, status, card, quantity, void) waits for the other side to confirm. Disputes need a reason. Nobody can confirm their own change.
